# **II. Software Design Document** {#ii.-software-design-document}

## **1\. System Design** {#1.-system-design}

### ***1.1 System Architecture*** {#1.1-system-architecture}

#### ***1.1.1 Front-end Architecture*** {#1.1.1-front-end-architecture}

![][image2] 

Figure 1.1.1. ReactJS \+ Vite Front-end Architecture

The browser runs a ReactJS application built with Vite; Node.js is used only for development and build. React Router directs users to public, customer, or back-office pages. Pages are built from reusable components, read the logged-in user from the authentication context, and call the Spring Boot REST API through Axios services that attach the JWT. For payment, the browser is redirected to the Payment Gateway checkout page and then returns to the payment result page, which reads the final status from the back-end.

#### ***1.1.2 Back-end Architecture*** {#1.1.2-back-end-architecture}

![][image3] 

Figure 1.1.2. Spring Boot Back-end Architecture

The back-end is a Spring Boot application organized by the MVC pattern. Spring Security checks the JWT and the user's role before a request reaches a controller. Controllers validate input and call services, which hold the business rules and use Spring Data JPA repositories to read and write Microsoft SQL Server. Services also call two external systems: Gmail SMTP for verification, password reset and notification emails, and the Payment Gateway for creating payments. The gateway returns the payment result to PaymentController through a callback; the back-end verifies it before marking the registration as Paid and granting course access.

Actors: Guest, Customer, Admin, Sale, Marketing, Staff, and Author (named Expert in the original requirement). Staff is a project-specified role with no documented standalone functions; no management permission is assumed. Gmail SMTP and the Payment Gateway are external systems, not user roles.

### ***1.2 Package Diagram*** {#1.2-package-diagram}

#### ***1.2.1 Front-end package diagram*** {#1.2.1-front-end-package-diagram}

![][image4] 

Figure 1.2.1. Front-end package diagram

Front-end package descriptions:

| No | Package | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | /src/pages | Public, customer and management screens, including the payment result page. |
| 02 | /src/components | Shared UI components for lists, forms and dialogs. |
| 03 | /src/services | Axios API calls to the Spring Boot backend, including payment creation and payment status. |
| 04 | /src/context | Authenticated user context used by route guards. |
| 05 | /src/routes | Route mapping and UI-level access control. |
| 06 | /src/layouts | Shared page layouts for the public site and the management dashboard. |

#### ***1.2.2 Back-end package diagram*** {#1.2.2-back-end-package-diagram}

![][image5] 

Figure 1.2.2. Back-end package diagram

Back-end package descriptions:

| No | Package | Description |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 01 | /controller | REST endpoints and HTTP responses. |
| 02 | /dto | Request/response payloads and input validation. |
| 03 | /security | Spring Security login and role authorization. |
| 04 | /service | Business rules for registration, payment, course access, lessons, quizzes, content and management. |
| 05 | /repository | Database operations using Spring Data JPA. |
| 06 | /entity | Persistence entities mapped to SQL Server. |
| 07 | /config | Application, database and external integration configuration. |
| 08 | /integration | Gmail SMTP email sending and the Payment Gateway client (create payment, verify callback, query status). |
| 09 | /exception | Global exception handler that converts errors into HTTP error responses. |

### ***2.3 Course Registration & Sales*** {#2.3-course-registration-&-sales}

The documented baseline is a Submitted registration created by Guest/Customer and managed by Sale. A registration becomes Paid only after the online payment is verified with the Payment Gateway; Paid triggers user lookup/creation and course access.

#### ***2.3.1 Class Diagram*** {#2.3.1-class-diagram}

![][image29] 

Figure 2.3.1(a). Course Registration & Sales Class Diagram

![][image30] 

Figure 2.3.1(b). Guest \- Course Register Class Diagram

#### ***2.3.2 Course Register*** {#2.3.2-course-register}

Guest can register without login; an authenticated Customer can reuse account contact data. Initial status: Submitted.

![][image31] 

Figure 2.3.2. Course Register Sequence Diagram

#### ***2.3.3 My Registrations*** {#2.3.3-my-registrations}

Customer sees own registrations. Edit/cancel is offered only while Submitted.

![][image32] 

Figure 2.3.3. My Registrations Sequence Diagram

#### ***2.3.4 Registrations List*** {#2.3.4-registrations-list}

Sale can filter by course, dates, status; search email; sort specified fields.

![][image33] 

Figure 2.3.4. Registrations List Sequence Diagram

#### ***2.3.5 Registration Details*** {#2.3.5-registration-details}

Sale can create registrations and change statuses with notes. Other fields may be edited only on registrations created by that Sale.

![][image34] 

Figure 2.3.5. Registration Details Sequence Diagram

#### ***2.3.6 Set Paid & Grant Course Access*** {#2.3.6-set-paid-&-grant-course-access}

For a transaction still pending, Sale asks the back-end to re-check it with the Payment Gateway. Only a confirmed SUCCESS with a matching amount sets the registration Paid, grants course access (one per registration) and notifies the learner by email; Sale cannot mark Paid without a verified payment.

![][image35] 

Figure 2.3.6. Set Paid & Grant Course Access Sequence Diagram

#### ***2.3.7 Online Payment & Verification*** {#2.3.7-online-payment-&-verification}

The Customer pays a Submitted registration online. The back-end creates a Pending transaction, redirects the Customer to the Payment Gateway and verifies the gateway callback (signature, order code and amount) before marking the registration Paid and granting course access. A transaction that was already processed is ignored; failed or cancelled payments never grant access.

The concrete provider (for example VNPay or PayOS) is configured in PaymentGatewayClient; refunds and settlement are out of scope.

![][image36] 

Figure 2.3.7. Online Payment & Verification Sequence Diagram

## **3\. Database Design** {#3.-database-design}

The OnlineLearn database runs on Microsoft SQL Server. Figure 3.1 shows the physical ERD with 20 tables covering accounts, marketing content, the course catalog, registration, online payment, course access and quizzes. Each table below lists its columns, SQL Server data types, required flags and keys (PK \= primary key, FK \= foreign key, UQ \= unique). Payment results are stored in payment\_transactions. A registration is set to Paid and a course\_access row is created only after the transaction is verified as successful; the unique keys on order\_code, provider\_txn\_ref and course\_access.registration\_id stop the same payment from being processed twice.

![][image77]   

*Figure 3.1. Physical ERD of the OnlineLearn database (Microsoft SQL Server)*

### **3.1 Users Schema** {#3.1-users-schema}

| \# | Field name | Type | Required | Reference | Note |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | user\_id | BIGINT IDENTITY | Yes | PK | User identifier |
| 2 | full\_name | NVARCHAR(150) | Yes | \- | Displayed name |
| 3 | gender | NVARCHAR(20) | No | \- | Profile value |
| 4 | email | NVARCHAR(254) | Yes | UNIQUE | Immutable after registration |
| 5 | mobile | VARCHAR(20) | No | \- | Customer contact |
| 6 | password\_hash | NVARCHAR(255) | No | \- | Never store plaintext password |
| 7 | role\_code | VARCHAR(30) | Yes | \- | Guest has no user row; 6 account roles |
| 8 | status | VARCHAR(20) | Yes | \- | Active / Inactive |
| 9 | email\_verified\_at | DATETIME2 | No | \- | Verification result |
| 10 | avatar\_url | NVARCHAR(500) | No | \- | Profile image |
| 11 | address | NVARCHAR(255) | No | \- | User detail |
| 12 | created\_at | DATETIME2 | Yes | \- | Created time |

### **3.2 Auth Tokens Schema** {#3.2-auth-tokens-schema}

| \# | Field name | Type | Required | Reference | Note |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | token\_id | BIGINT IDENTITY | Yes | PK | One-time token ID |
| 2 | user\_id | BIGINT | Yes | users(user\_id) | Owner |
| 3 | token\_hash | VARCHAR(128) | Yes | UNIQUE | Verification or reset token hash |
| 4 | purpose | VARCHAR(25) | Yes | \- | VERIFY\_EMAIL / RESET\_PASSWORD |
| 5 | expires\_at | DATETIME2 | Yes | \- | Expiration time (configurable) |
| 6 | consumed\_at | DATETIME2 | No | \- | Single-use marker |

### **3.3 Settings Schema** {#3.3-settings-schema}

| \# | Field name | Type | Required | Reference | Note |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | setting\_id | BIGINT IDENTITY | Yes | PK | Setting ID |
| 2 | type | VARCHAR(50) | Yes | \- | Role, category, level, type, etc. |
| 3 | value | NVARCHAR(200) | Yes | \- | Configured value |
| 4 | sort\_order | INT | No | \- | Menu/display order |
| 5 | description | NVARCHAR(500) | No | \- | Notes |
| 6 | status | VARCHAR(20) | Yes | \- | Active / Inactive |

### **3.4 Subjects Schema** {#3.4-subjects-schema}

| \# | Field name | Type | Required | Reference | Note |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | subject\_id | BIGINT IDENTITY | Yes | PK | Course ID |
| 2 | name | NVARCHAR(200) | Yes | \- | Course name |
| 3 | owner\_user\_id | BIGINT | Yes | users(user\_id) | Assigned Author |
| 4 | category\_setting\_id | BIGINT | Yes | settings(setting\_id) | Subject Category setting |
| 5 | tagline | NVARCHAR(255) | No | \- | Public brief tagline |
| 6 | thumbnail\_url | NVARCHAR(500) | No | \- | Image URL |
| 7 | description | NVARCHAR(MAX) | No | \- | Subject content |
| 8 | featured | BIT | Yes | \- | Featured flag |
| 9 | publish\_status | VARCHAR(20) | Yes | \- | Published / Unpublished |
| 10 | updated\_at | DATETIME2 | Yes | \- | Last update time |

### **3.5 Subject Dimensions Schema** {#3.5-subject-dimensions-schema}

| \# | Field name | Type | Required | Reference | Note |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | dimension\_id | BIGINT IDENTITY | Yes | PK | Dimension ID |
| 2 | subject\_id | BIGINT | Yes | subjects(subject\_id) | Owning subject |
| 3 | type\_setting\_id | BIGINT | Yes | settings(setting\_id) | Domain / Group classification |
| 4 | name | NVARCHAR(150) | Yes | \- | Dimension name |
| 5 | description | NVARCHAR(500) | No | \- | Dimension detail |

### **3.6 Price Packages Schema** {#3.6-price-packages-schema}

| \# | Field name | Type | Required | Reference | Note |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | package\_id | BIGINT IDENTITY | Yes | PK | Package ID |
| 2 | subject\_id | BIGINT | Yes | subjects(subject\_id) | Owning subject |
| 3 | name | NVARCHAR(150) | Yes | \- | Price package name |
| 4 | duration\_months | INT | Yes | \- | Positive access duration |
| 5 | list\_price | DECIMAL(18,2) | Yes | \- | Non-negative list price |
| 6 | sale\_price | DECIMAL(18,2) | Yes | \- | Non-negative sale price |
| 7 | description | NVARCHAR(500) | No | \- | Package notes |
| 8 | status | VARCHAR(20) | Yes | \- | Active / Inactive |

### **3.7 Lessons Schema** {#3.7-lessons-schema}

| \# | Field name | Type | Required | Reference | Note |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | lesson\_id | BIGINT IDENTITY | Yes | PK | Lesson ID |
| 2 | subject\_id | BIGINT | Yes | subjects(subject\_id) | Owning subject |
| 3 | package\_id | BIGINT | No | price\_packages(package\_id) | Optional package restriction (to confirm) |
| 4 | parent\_topic\_id | BIGINT | No | lessons(lesson\_id) | Subject Topic parent |
| 5 | quiz\_id | BIGINT | No | quizzes(quiz\_id) | Link when type \= Quiz |
| 6 | name | NVARCHAR(200) | Yes | \- | Lesson title |
| 7 | lesson\_type | VARCHAR(30) | Yes | \- | Subject Topic / Lesson / Quiz |
| 8 | sort\_order | INT | Yes | \- | Display order |
| 9 | video\_url | NVARCHAR(500) | No | \- | For media lesson |
| 10 | html\_content | NVARCHAR(MAX) | No | \- | For HTML lesson |
| 11 | status | VARCHAR(20) | Yes | \- | Active / Inactive |

### **3.8 Registrations Schema** {#3.8-registrations-schema}

| \# | Field name | Type | Required | Reference | Note |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | registration\_id | BIGINT IDENTITY | Yes | PK | Registration ID |
| 2 | customer\_user\_id | BIGINT | No | users(user\_id) | Null for guest registration |
| 3 | package\_id | BIGINT | Yes | price\_packages(package\_id) | Selected package |
| 4 | full\_name | NVARCHAR(150) | Yes | \- | Registrant name |
| 5 | email | NVARCHAR(254) | Yes | \- | Lookup key for Sale \-\> user |
| 6 | mobile | VARCHAR(20) | Yes | \- | Registration contact |
| 7 | gender | NVARCHAR(20) | No | \- | Registrant gender |
| 8 | total\_cost | DECIMAL(18,2) | Yes | \- | Price at registration |
| 9 | status | VARCHAR(20) | Yes | \- | Submitted / Paid / Cancelled |
| 10 | registered\_at | DATETIME2 | Yes | \- | Registration timestamp |
| 11 | valid\_from | DATETIME2 | No | \- | Access start after Paid |
| 12 | valid\_to | DATETIME2 | No | \- | Access end after Paid |
| 13 | updated\_by | BIGINT | No | users(user\_id) | Responsible Sale user |
| 14 | notes | NVARCHAR(MAX) | No | \- | Sale notes |
| 15 | updated\_at | DATETIME2 | No | \- | Last status change (e.g. Submitted to Paid) |

### **3.9 Course Access Schema** {#3.9-course-access-schema}

| \# | Field name | Type | Required | Reference | Note |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | access\_id | BIGINT IDENTITY | Yes | PK | Access ID |
| 2 | user\_id | BIGINT | Yes | users(user\_id) | Learner |
| 3 | subject\_id | BIGINT | Yes | subjects(subject\_id) | Accessed course |
| 4 | registration\_id | BIGINT | Yes | registrations(registration\_id) | Granted from paid registration; UNIQUE, one access per registration |
| 5 | valid\_from | DATETIME2 | Yes | \- | Access starts |
| 6 | valid\_to | DATETIME2 | Yes | \- | Access expires |

| 3 | lesson\_id | BIGINT | Yes | lessons(lesson\_id) | Completed lesson |
| 4 | is\_completed | BIT | Yes | \- | Proposed completion flag |
| 5 | updated\_at | DATETIME2 | Yes | \- | Updated time |

| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |

| 4 | level\_setting\_id | BIGINT | Yes | settings(setting\_id) | Easy/Medium/Hard |
| 5 | content | NVARCHAR(MAX) | Yes | \- | Question body |
| 6 | media\_url | NVARCHAR(500) | No | \- | Optional image/audio/video |
| 7 | media\_type | VARCHAR(20) | No | \- | Media type |
| 8 | explanation | NVARCHAR(MAX) | No | \- | Shown if not empty |
| 9 | status | VARCHAR(20) | Yes | \- | Active / Inactive |

| \# | Field name | Type | Required | Reference | Note |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| 1 | option\_id | BIGINT IDENTITY | Yes | PK | Option ID |
| 2 | question\_id | BIGINT | Yes | questions(question\_id) | Parent question |
| 3 | content | NVARCHAR(MAX) | Yes | \- | Answer option text |
| 4 | is\_correct | BIT | Yes | \- | Correct answer flag |
| 5 | sort\_order | INT | Yes | \- | Option order |

| \# | Field name | Type | Required | Reference | Note |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |

| 9 | checkout\_url | NVARCHAR(500) | No | \- | Gateway payment page link |
| 10 | paid\_at | DATETIME2 | No | \- | Time the gateway confirmed payment |
| 11 | raw\_response | NVARCHAR(MAX) | No | \- | Verified callback or query data, kept for audit |
| 12 | created\_at | DATETIME2 | Yes | \- | Created time |
| 13 | updated\_at | DATETIME2 | Yes | \- | Last status change |
